social_formats.description: Caller-free group dancing featuring simpler and older dances such as snake dances and furry dances to maximize participation in community settings.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Open winding chains and lines (snake dances, furry dances) travelling through the hall
movement_profile.partnering: Caller-free communal chain and line formats

signature_moves.description: A winding chain dance where participants link and follow the leader through the space without a caller.
signature_moves.name: Snake dance

signature_moves.description: An ancient Cornish processional dance form adapted into the caller-free nos lowen repertoire.
signature_moves.name: Furry dance

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid relying on a caller or interrupting the continuous flow of the chain.

music_profile.musical_form: Longer, progressive song arrangements with driving repetition
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Repetitive, driving rhythms designed to induce a trance-like state
music_profile.sound_description: The music of nos lowen is defined by an energetic, progressive folk style tailored for social dancing. It emphasizes strong, hypnotic rhythms and long, extended pieces rather than brief tunes. The repetitive rhythmic drive is structured to lock the entire room into a sustained, collective trance.
music_profile.vocal_style: Extended songs, vocal details not described in sources

teaching.formation: Snake dances and furry dance chains; winding lines without a caller
teaching.level_notes: Designed for maximum accessibility, allowing complete beginners to join moving chains without verbal calling or prior rehearsal.
teaching.rhythm: Heavy rhythmic emphasis supporting extended dancing, specific counts not described in sources
